def nightly_report(rows):
    lines = []
    total = 0
    skipped = 0
    for row in rows:
        name = row["name"].strip().title()
        amount = int(row.get("amount", 0))
        if amount < 0:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        total += amount
        days_late = int(row.get("days_late", 0))
        flags = []
        if row.get("suspended"):
            flags.append("suspended")
        if days_late <= 14:
            flags.append("in-grace")
        else:
            flags.append("overdue")
        if amount > 100:
            flags.append("large")
        lines.append(f"{name}: {amount} [{', '.join(flags)}]")
    lines.append(f"total={total} skipped={skipped}")
    return lines
